dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Interconnected irregular polygonal and circular rings characterized by high-intensity light-grey perimeters; transitions from darker charcoal-grey exterior skin to sharp, non-uniform light-intensity edges are clearly defined.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, isolated high-intensity white punctates concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region near the neck transition and more sparsely distributed toward the posterior-dorsal flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-midline annuli form a nearly equilateral triangle, while the four most prominent lateral annuli form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized cluster of approximately 6-8 distinct, circular, high-saturation red punctates observed on the lower mid-flank ventral to the primary ring patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique honeycomb-like interlocking structure formed by adjacent macro-annuli in the dorsal-central quadrant, creating a continuous network of shared high-contrast boundaries.
